title: LG to Ban Residential Proxy Networks from Smart TV Apps
metaDescription: LG to ban smart TV apps from being used as residential proxy nodes. Learn about the prevalence of proxy SDKs in webOS apps and how to protect your smart TV privacy.

structuredData.headline: LG to Ban Residential Proxy Networks from Smart TV Apps
structuredData.description: LG will suspend smart TV apps acting as residential proxy nodes. With 42% of webOS apps containing proxy SDKs, this move addresses privacy violations and lack of informed consent. Developers must remove proxy features or face suspension.
